name: Nidhi Granites Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1981, Nidhi Granites Ltd is a  manufacturer of granite and marble slabs,  
tiles, and sandstone and limestone products.
keyPoints: Product Profile:[1] Grey Sandstone, Granites, Marbles, Granite Blocks, Rajasthan black granite, Floor Marble, Sandstone Marbles

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Debtor days have improved from 58.6 to 36.4 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 81.4 days to 62.0 days
cons: Stock is trading at 17.4 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 9.58% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 40.3% of their holding.
